# Held-out exercises for performance-measurement, written without reading the skill text.

# What a viewer may see is part of the answer, so it is part of the cache key, and
# the version the database offers is what keeps the answer current.
[viewer-memo] the project dashboard is slow because every page view recomputes the project summary, make repeat views cheap | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# Render only the rows returned, and still filter and sort before cutting the page.
[page-first] the document list takes seconds for large workspaces, it renders a preview for every document before returning one page of 20, make it faster | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
